      "content": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, DateTime, ForeignKey\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import relationship\nfrom database import Base\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    full_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Program(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"programs\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    term = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Applicant(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"applicants\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    applicant_code = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    mailing_address = Column(String)\n    city = Column(String)\n    state = Column(String)\n    postal_code = Column(String)\n    program_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"programs.id\", ondelete=\"RESTRICT\", onupdate=\"CASCADE\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationship to Program\n    program = relationship(\"Program\")\n\n\nclass ApplicantNote(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"applicant_notes\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    applicant_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"applicants.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\", onupdate=\"CASCADE\"))\n    user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\", ondelete=\"RESTRICT\", onupdate=\"CASCADE\"))\n    note = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)"

      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom sqlalchemy import and_\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Applicant, Program\nfrom schemas import ApplicantOut, ApplicantUpdateIn\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api/applicants\",\n    tags=[\"Applicants\"]\n)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{applicant_code}\", response_model=ApplicantOut, operation_id=\"applicants_get_applicant_by_code\")\nasync def get_applicant_by_code(\n    applicant_code: str,\n    program_name: str,\n    program_term: str,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    applicant = db.query(Applicant).join(Program).filter(\n        and_(\n            Applicant.applicant_code == applicant_code,\n            Program.name == program_name,\n            Program.term == program_term\n        )\n    ).first()\n\n    if not applicant:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Applicant not found\")\n\n    return applicant\n\n\n@router.patch(\"/{applicant_code}\", response_model=ApplicantOut, operation_id=\"applicants_update_applicant_contact\")\nasync def update_applicant_contact(\n    applicant_code: str,\n    payload: ApplicantUpdateIn,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    applicant = db.query(Applicant).filter(Applicant.applicant_code == applicant_code).first()\n\n    if not applicant:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Applicant not found\")\n\n    # Update fields if provided\n    if payload.phone is not None:\n        applicant.phone = payload.phone\n    if payload.mailing_address is not None:\n        applicant.mailing_address = payload.mailing_address\n    if payload.city is not None:\n        applicant.city = payload.city\n    if payload.state is not None:\n        applicant.state = payload.state\n    if payload.postal_code is not None:\n        applicant.postal_code = payload.postal_code\n\n    applicant.updated_at = datetime.utcnow()\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(applicant)\n\n    # Re-query to include program info\n    updated_applicant = db.query(Applicant).join(Program).filter(\n        Applicant.applicant_code == applicant_code\n    ).first()\n\n    return updated_applicant"
    },

      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status, Request\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Applicant, ApplicantNote, User\nfrom schemas import ApplicantNoteIn, ApplicantNoteOut\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api/applicants\",\n    tags=[\"ApplicantNotes\"]\n)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{applicant_id}/notes\", response_model=ApplicantNoteOut, operation_id=\"applicant_notes_create_note\")\nasync def create_applicant_note(\n    applicant_id: int,\n    payload: ApplicantNoteIn,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Check if applicant exists\n    applicant = db.query(Applicant).filter(Applicant.id == applicant_id).first()\n    if not applicant:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Applicant not found\")\n\n    # Get current user (in real app, this would come from auth middleware)\n    # For now, we'll assume user_id is 1 (Sarah Mitchell) as per sample data\n    user_id = 1  # This should be extracted from the request context in a real implementation\n\n    note = ApplicantNote(\n        applicant_id=applicant_id,\n        user_id=user_id,\n        note=payload.note\n    )\n\n    db.add(note)\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(note)\n\n    return note"
